requiredFindings.title: The C.store join has no retained decode
requiredFindings.failureScenario: state.v1 is present and private, and its C.store differs from the admitted (S, G, K), or the bytes do not decode. Item 2 retains decoded values for the pair, the marker and the nodes only, and admission adds no file read. Both sessions open trust/stores/S/state.v1 with no byte cap, so C.store is not a retained value and an undecodable record is not an item 5 structural kind. SelectedStoreEndpoint is still granted. The F27 endpoint join is skipped, and no later unit may repeat it.

scope: Law X3a r2. RF-2, RF-3 and RF-4 are closed. Extending 458c item 12 with two doctor-only subjects is accepted. RF-1 stays open: the C.store comparison has no retained decode. Live HEAD f7acb6d is X1a plus design-lock; the trust-current read and gate_refusal are the fdbedf4 bytes. No product cargo.
